info.name: AI Agent Voice - dev-test - All APIs
info.description: Synchronized with the current Admin router. SQLite and WS Device admission are always required. Admin routes are mounted only when api.enabled=true. Removed database/admission config switches must not be sent. Admin requests require `Authorization: Bearer {{admin_token}}`. PATCH/PUT/DELETE mutations that use optimistic concurrency require `If-Match: "<revision>"`. This file groups logical API collections as folders so it can be imported once.

request.description: Process liveness. Returns `ok` while the process is running.
Readiness for accepting new voice connections. Returns 200 `ready` or 503 with a bounded reason.
Safe aggregate status: readiness, version, uptime, database, provider counts and active sessions. It never returns paths, configuration, secrets or raw runtime failures.

Enrollment defaults to transport=websocket: unknown devices get websocket URL/transport token without activation, then WS hello/stt/tts/Opus presents the code. transport=ota preserves activation without websocket/token. Registered devices get websocket; blocked devices get 403. Prepare static WAV assets before enabling WS enrollment.
Same handler/response as GET; kept for Xiaozhi compatibility.
202 while an enrollment is pending; 200 once a Device and enabled Agent exist.
CORS/preflight compatibility endpoint.

WebSocket upgrade endpoint. Postman Collection v2.1 stores this as an HTTP contract reference; open a Postman WebSocket request using `{{ws_url}}/voice/v1/` with the same headers to exercise the socket. Protocol-Version may be omitted by legacy clients; Device-Id and Client-Id are required. Authorization is required only when auth.token is non-empty.
Available only when vision.enabled=true. Returns a readiness/status string.

formdata.value: Hãy mô tả hình ảnh này.

request.description: Multipart request. Required fields: question and image/file. Supported image signatures: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WebP. Authorization is required only when auth.token is non-empty.
CORS/preflight compatibility endpoint.
Query: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200, optional enabled, sort in key|name|-key|-name.
key: lowercase letter first, then lowercase/digit/underscore, max 64. name max 128; description max 2048.
key is immutable. Null may clear nullable fields such as description; If-Match must contain the current quoted revision.
Conditional hard-delete. Returns 204 only when no active Device, Template assignment, MCP binding or History reference remains; otherwise 409 agent_in_use. Does not change an admitted Voice Session.
Lists active Template assignments with template enabled state and is_default. Pagination: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200.
Assigns the template to the agent and increments the agent revision.
Soft-unlinks an active assignment and increments the Agent revision. This may remove the default assignment; if none remain, new sessions use server defaults.
Sets an already-valid template as the agent default and increments the agent revision.
Query: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200, optional enabled, sort in device_id|name|-device_id|-name.
Consumes one six-digit activation code and returns the created Device. The code is a string to preserve leading zeroes.
template_key is optional; when present it must be an enabled Template assigned to agent_key. Omit it to use the Agent default Template.

device_id is immutable. agent_key cannot be null. template_key may be null to clear the override, or must name an enabled Template assigned to agent_key. If-Match must contain the current quoted device revision.
Conditional hard-delete. Returns 204 only when the Device has no History reference; otherwise 409 device_in_use.
Query: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200, optional enabled, q (key/name/description), language and sort in key|-key|name|-name|language. Response includes total and total_pages.

request.description: key is immutable. If-Match must contain the current quoted template revision.
Conditional hard-delete. Returns 204 only when no active Agent assignment, Provider binding, Device override or History reference remains; otherwise 409 template_in_use.
provider_type must be one of vad|asr|llm|tts. Increments template revision.
Lists active Agent assignments that use this Template, including Agent enabled state and is_default. Pagination: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200.
Returns the persisted Provider binding map for the Template. This is desired configuration and does not refresh runtime.
Removes one persisted Provider binding and increments the Template revision. It does not hot-reload runtime.
Agent-side association. Uses the agent revision, not template revision.
Uses the agent revision and increments it.
Query: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200, optional enabled, q, type=vad|asr|llm|tts and sort in key|-key|name|-name. Response includes total, total_pages and facets by provider type.

Provider key is generated by the server and returned in the 201 response. Clients must not send key in the create request; an unknown field is rejected with 400 invalid_json. Remote Provider requests may include an optional top-level api_key, encrypted with AES-256-GCM in SQLite; responses only expose masked credential metadata. VOICE_PROVIDER_<PROVIDER_KEY>_API_KEY remains the deployment fallback. Submit secrets over HTTPS. type must be vad|asr|llm|tts and adapter must match the type.
Runtime metadata reads do not build models or refresh cache TTL.

Optional top-level api_key is encrypted in SQLite and write-only; responses expose credential masked metadata. Omit api_key on PATCH to keep it. Submit secrets over HTTPS. key is server-generated and immutable; sending it returns 400 immutable_field. type is not patchable. Managed runtimes acquire the exact desired revision for new sessions and diagnostics. Existing admitted sessions retain their snapshot and lease. Inspect runtime.desired_state, ready_revisions and can_prepare; requires_restart is explicit only for unsupported changes.

Idempotently acquire the current desired revision without user inference. Strict empty JSON body. 200 ready; 202 queued/loading; 409 disabled/conflict; 429 bounded capacity; 503 infrastructure failure; 504 acquisition deadline. Response identifies provider key, desired revision and safe runtime state. Poll GET metadata; a desired revision change starts a new view.

Conditional hard-delete. Returns 204 only when no Template Provider Binding remains; otherwise 409 provider_in_use. Existing sessions retain their exact runtime lease until cleanup; deleting desired state does not invalidate admitted sessions.

Lists persisted Template usage for this Provider, including binding type and Template enabled state. Pagination: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200. Runtime metadata reads do not build models or refresh cache TTL.
Requires the DB provider runtime to be loaded and its compiled adapter descriptor to expose capabilities.

Tests the loaded LLM runtime only. JSON body rejects unknown fields. With the manager enabled, an enabled unbound or cold provider can be acquired under bounded load/RAM capacity. JSON results include exact provider_id and provider_revision; TTS WAV returns X-Provider-Id and X-Provider-Revision.

Returns audio/wav on success. voice and language are optional typed overrides. With the manager enabled, an enabled unbound or cold provider can be acquired under bounded load/RAM capacity. JSON results include exact provider_id and provider_revision; TTS WAV returns X-Provider-Id and X-Provider-Revision.

Upload PCM WAV. Expected: mono 16 kHz PCM, duration <= 30 s, request body <= 5 MiB. With the manager enabled, an enabled unbound or cold provider can be acquired under bounded load/RAM capacity. JSON results include exact provider_id and provider_revision; TTS WAV returns X-Provider-Id and X-Provider-Revision.

No request body. Tests exactly one canonical silent VAD inference frame on the already-loaded runtime. Returns probability, sample range, elapsed time and runtime provenance; provider_key must identify a VAD Provider Instance. With the manager enabled, an enabled unbound or cold provider can be acquired under bounded load/RAM capacity. JSON results include exact provider_id and provider_revision; TTS WAV returns X-Provider-Id and X-Provider-Revision.
Lists compiled provider adapter descriptors.
Only query key allowed is type; value must be a supported provider type.
Bootstrap discovery is adapter-specific. Unsupported adapters return conflict; invalid selections return 400.
Pagination: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200.

transport is fixed to streamable_http. auth is {type:none}, {type:bearer}, or {type:header,header_name:x-api-key}. An optional top-level api_key is accepted for bearer/header auth, encrypted with AES-256-GCM in SQLite; responses expose credential masked metadata only. Omit api_key on PATCH to keep the current key. Deployment VOICE_MCP_<SERVER_KEY>_TOKEN is the fallback. Submit secrets over HTTPS. Arbitrary request headers are not persisted. URL is validated by the deployment outbound network policy.
key is immutable. If-Match must contain the current quoted MCP server revision.
Conditional hard-delete. Returns 204 only when no Agent MCP Binding remains; otherwise 409 mcp_server_in_use.
required=true is currently rejected as required_unsupported. Binding mutation increments the agent revision.
Physically removes the Agent MCP Binding, increments the Agent revision and returns 204. Unlink this before deleting an MCP Server.

Approval revision is separate from Agent/observation revision. Fresh approval revision=1; exact observed fingerprint/revision required. Sensitive tools remain blocked. New grant applies only to new WS; revoke closes affected WS1008.
Optional filters: session_id, device_id, agent_id, template_id, role=user|assistant. Integer IDs are database row IDs, not external device_id strings. sort: created_at|-created_at|sequence|-sequence.
Exactly one purge scope is allowed: session_id, device_id, or all.

item.name: Purge history by device DB id

request.description: device_id here is the positive integer database row ID.
Irreversible full-history purge. Both literals are required.
Built-in CAM++ server capability, embedding space, audio bounds and quota; no mutable Speaker Provider or calibration.

Query: page 1..10000, page_size 1..200, optional enabled, enrollment_status=enrolled|unenrolled|draft, provider_key and sort in key|-key|name|-name|updated_at|-updated_at|revision|-revision. Returns items, page, page_size and total.

Create an un-enrolled Speaker profile. Body: key, name, optional description. A duplicate key returns 409 speaker_key_conflict; the deployment speaker cap returns 409 speaker_quota_exceeded. Response is 201 with ETag: "<revision>".

Speaker detail with per-space voiceprint metadata and open enrollment drafts. Optional ?provider_key filters voiceprints. Response includes ETag: "<revision>". An un-enrolled profile has an empty voiceprints array and is not a usable candidate.

CAS update of name, description (null clears) and/or enabled. Requires If-Match: "<speaker revision>". Missing/invalid If-Match returns 400; a stale revision returns 409 revision_conflict. Response carries the new ETag.

Conditional hard delete. Requires If-Match: "<speaker revision>". Deletes the profile and its owned voiceprints and captures. Returns 204, or 409 speaker_in_use while an agent candidate still references the speaker.
Upload PCM16 mono16kHz WAV; server extracts a bounded embedding and holds it for 10 minutes; no Provider key, revision, or voice authentication.
Creates Speaker and one voiceprint atomically, idempotent by capture ID.
Re-enroll existing Speaker from capture. If-Match is Speaker revision; Agent bindings and name remain.
Delete voiceprint(s) but keep metadata.
Mode off|observe; observe means advisory identity for a turn, never authorization.
Toggle identification; no Required mode or calibration.
Agent-scoped candidates; independent of Template grants.
Direct link with empty JSON body.
Unlink candidate; recognition snapshot applies at reconnect.
Returns Agent keys, never Template grants.
